Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure shows a slice of the plenoptic function sampled at four spatial locations: two in free space and two inside a pinhole camera. At each location, the plenoptic function encodes the intensity of light rays passing through that point from every direction. The locations inside the pinhole camera show that most directional values are zero, with only specific directions carrying non-zero intensity due to the camera aperture. The figure introduces the plenoptic function as a complete representation of all light in a scene, motivating its use in neural radiance fields (NeRFs).

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Click to move the sampling point anywhere in the scene; display the angular light distribution at that point
- Toggle between free-space and inside-camera locations to contrast the dense vs sparse plenoptic function

SOURCE FILE: visionbook/nerf.qmd

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

var W = 960, H = 640; draw.viewbox(0, 0, W, H); draw.node.style.cursor = 'crosshair'; /* ── Scene model: shared by the visuals AND the ray caster ── */ var CAM = { x0: 70, y0: 270, x1: 330, y1: 560, gap0: 380, gap1: 445 }; // pinhole = gap in right wall var CANOPY = { cx: 705, cy: 210, rx: 140, ry: 125 }; var TRUNK = [[683, 295], [748, 295], [806, 620], [648, 620]]; var BIRD = { cx: 885, cy: 62, r: 22 }; var SKY_V = 0.9, CANOPY_V = 0.55, TRUNK_V = 0.35, BIRD_V = 0.15, BOX_V = 0.15; var R_OUT = 78, R_IN = 27, DOT_R = 14; /* ── Ray casting: intensity arriving at (px,py) from unit direction (ux,uy) ── */ function insideBox(px, py) { return px > CAM.x0 && px < CAM.x1 && py > CAM.y0 && py < CAM.y1; } function boxExit(px, py, ux, uy) { var best = { t: Infinity, wall: 'none', x: px, y: py }, t; if (ux > 1e-9) { t = (CAM.x1 - px) / ux; if (t < best.t) best = { t: t, wall: 'right', x: CAM.x1, y: py + uy * t }; } if (ux < -1e-9) { t = (CAM.x0 - px) / ux; if (t < best.t) best = { t: t, wall: 'left', x: CAM.x0, y: py + uy * t }; } if (uy > 1e-9) { t = (CAM.y1 - py) / uy; if (t < best.t) best = { t: t, wall: 'bottom', x: px + ux * t, y: CAM.y1 }; } if (uy < -1e-9) { t = (CAM.y0 - py) / uy; if (t < best.t) best = { t: t, wall: 'top', x: px + ux * t, y: CAM.y0 }; } return best; } function rayEllipse(px, py, ux, uy, E) { var ox = (px - E.cx) / E.rx, oy = (py - E.cy) / E.ry; var dx = ux / E.rx, dy = uy / E.ry; var a = dx * dx + dy * dy, b = 2 * (ox * dx + oy * dy), c = ox * ox + oy * oy - 1; var disc = b * b - 4 * a * c; if (disc < 0) return null; var sq = Math.sqrt(disc), t = (-b - sq) / (2 * a); if (t > 1) return t; t = (-b + sq) / (2 * a); return t > 1 ? t : null; } function rayCircle(px, py, ux, uy, C) { return rayEllipse(px, py, ux, uy, { cx: C.cx, cy: C.cy, rx: C.r, ry: C.r }); } function raySeg(px, py, ux, uy, x1, y1, x2, y2) { var ex = x2 - x1, ey = y2 - y1; var det = ex * uy - ux * ey; if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-9) return null; var t = (ex * (y1 - py) - ey * (x1 - px)) / det; var s = (ux * (y1 - py) - uy * (x1 - px)) / det; return (s >= 0 && s <= 1 && t > 1) ? t : null; } function rayBoxEnter(px, py, ux, uy) { var t1, t2, s1, s2, tmp; if (Math.abs(ux) < 1e-9) { if (px < CAM.x0 || px > CAM.x1) return null; t1 = -1e18; t2 = 1e18; } else { t1 = (CAM.x0 - px) / ux; t2 = (CAM.x1 - px) / ux; if (t1 > t2) { tmp = t1; t1 = t2; t2 = tmp; } } if (Math.abs(uy) < 1e-9) { if (py < CAM.y0 || py > CAM.y1) return null; s1 = -1e18; s2 = 1e18; } else { s1 = (CAM.y0 - py) / uy; s2 = (CAM.y1 - py) / uy; if (s1 > s2) { tmp = s1; s1 = s2; s2 = tmp; } } var tE = Math.max(t1, s1), tX = Math.min(t2, s2); return (tE < tX && tX > 1 && tE > 1) ? tE : null; } function outsideHit(px, py, ux, uy) { var tBest = Infinity, val = SKY_V, t, i, a, b; t = rayEllipse(px, py, ux, uy, CANOPY); if (t !== null && t < tBest) { tBest = t; val = CANOPY_V; } t = rayCircle(px, py, ux, uy, BIRD); if (t !== null && t < tBest) { tBest = t; val = BIRD_V; } for (i = 0; i < TRUNK.length; i++) { a = TRUNK[i]; b = TRUNK[(i + 1) % TRUNK.length]; t = raySeg(px, py, ux, uy, a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]); if (t !== null && t < tBest) { tBest = t; val = TRUNK_V; } } t = rayBoxEnter(px, py, ux, uy); if (t !== null && t < tBest) { tBest = t; val = BOX_V; } return val; } function castRay(px, py, ux, uy) { if (insideBox(px, py)) { var hit = boxExit(px, py, ux, uy); if (hit.wall === 'right' && hit.y > CAM.gap0 && hit.y < CAM.gap1) { return outsideHit(hit.x + ux * 1.5, hit.y + uy * 1.5, ux, uy); // escaped through the pinhole } return 0; // absorbed by the box interior } return outsideHit(px, py, ux, uy); } /* ── Groups: static scene, overview (4 samples), explore (1 sample), polar readout ── */ var sceneG = draw.group(); var overviewG = draw.group(); var exploreG = draw.group(); var polarG = draw.group(); /* ── Static scene ── */ sceneG.rect(W, H).fill('#ffffff'); sceneG.text('Pinhole camera') .font({ family: "Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif", size: 34 }) .move(64, 248).fill('#111'); var trunkEl = sceneG.polygon(TRUNK).fill('#7a4a1c').stroke({ color: '#5e3812', width: 2 }); var canopyEl = sceneG.path('M 547 232 C 535 165 590 108 657 104 C 680 78 741 78 763 104 ' + 'C 837 92 883 152 861 222 C 887 262 853 314 785 306 C 735 332 641 328 603 302 C 555 302 541 268 547 232 Z') .fill('#27c200').stroke({ color: '#1f9e00', width: 2 }); var birdG = sceneG.group().translate(885, 62); birdG.polygon([[-16, -2], [-33, -11], [-29, 3]]).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#111', width: 2 }); birdG.ellipse(34, 20).center(0, 0).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#111', width: 2.2 }); birdG.circle(13).center(15, -11).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#111', width: 2.2 }); birdG.polygon([[20, -14], [33, -10], [20, -5]]).fill('#111'); birdG.path('M -7 -6 Q 1 -18 12 -14').fill('none').stroke({ color: '#111', width: 2 }); birdG.circle(2.4).center(17, -12).fill('#111'); var wallStroke = { color: '#111', width: 5, linecap: 'square' }; [ sceneG.line(CAM.x0, CAM.y0, CAM.x0, CAM.y1).stroke(wallStroke), sceneG.line(CAM.x0, CAM.y0, CAM.x1, CAM.y0).stroke(wallStroke), sceneG.line(CAM.x0, CAM.y1, CAM.x1, CAM.y1).stroke(wallStroke), sceneG.line(CAM.x1, CAM.y0, CAM.x1, CAM.gap0).stroke(wallStroke), sceneG.line(CAM.x1, CAM.gap1, CAM.x1, CAM.y1).stroke(wallStroke) ].forEach(function (el) { el.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Camera body — blocks light from these directions', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); }); var pinholeHot = sceneG.rect(30, CAM.gap1 - CAM.gap0 + 18).move(CAM.x1 - 15, CAM.gap0 - 9) .fill('#ffffff').attr('opacity', 0); pinholeHot.css('cursor', 'help'); pinholeHot.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Pinhole aperture — the only way light enters the box', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); canopyEl.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Tree canopy — scatters light toward every point of the scene', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); trunkEl.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Trunk — another light-scattering surface', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); birdG.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Bird — another light-scattering object', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); /* ── Spokes, arrowheads, dots ── */ function arrowHead(g, tx, ty, dx, dy) { var ahL = 11, ahW = 5.5; var plx = -dy, ply = dx; var bx = tx - dx * ahL, by = ty - dy * ahL; g.polygon([[tx, ty], [bx + plx * ahW, by + ply * ahW], [bx - plx * ahW, by - ply * ahW]]).fill('#111'); } function drawSpokes(g, px, py, K, zerosOnly) { var black = 0, inside = insideBox(px, py); for (var i = 0; i < K; i++) { var th = 2 * Math.PI * i / K; var ux = Math.cos(th), uy = -Math.sin(th); var v = castRay(px, py, ux, uy); var ix = px + ux * R_IN, iy = py + uy * R_IN; if (v > 0.05 && !zerosOnly) { black++; var dist = R_OUT; if (inside) { var ex = boxExit(px, py, ux, uy); if (ex.wall === 'right' && ex.y > CAM.gap0 && ex.y < CAM.gap1) dist = ex.t + 14; // ray exits via pinhole } g.line(px + ux * dist, py + uy * dist, ix, iy).stroke({ color: '#111', width: 3.4, linecap: 'round' }); arrowHead(g, ix, iy, -ux, -uy); } else if (v <= 0.05) { var gd = R_OUT; if (inside) { var e2 = boxExit(px, py, ux, uy); if (isFinite(e2.t)) gd = Math.max(R_IN + 8, Math.min(R_OUT, e2.t - 6)); } g.line(px + ux * gd, py + uy * gd, ix, iy).stroke({ color: '#cfcfcf', width: 1.4, linecap: 'round', opacity: 0.8 }); } } return black; } function drawGapRay(g, dot, gapY) { var ux = dot[0] - CAM.x1, uy = dot[1] - gapY; var L = Math.hypot(ux, uy); ux /= L; uy /= L; var sx = CAM.x1 - ux * 16, sy = gapY - uy * 16; var tx = dot[0] - ux * R_IN, ty = dot[1] - uy * R_IN; g.line(sx, sy, tx, ty).stroke({ color: '#111', width: 3.4, linecap: 'round' }); arrowHead(g, tx, ty, ux, uy); } function drawDot(g, px, py) { var c = g.circle(DOT_R * 2).center(px, py).fill('#f11212').stroke({ color: '#ffffff', width: 2.5 }); c.css('cursor', 'pointer'); c.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Sampling point — the plenoptic function L(x, θ) is evaluated here', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Plenoptic sample', 'At this point the plenoptic function L(x, θ) stores the intensity of light arriving from every direction θ. Black arrows are sampled directions that carry light; faint gray spokes carry almost none. The polar plot shows the same function as intensity versus angle.'); }); } /* ── Polar readout of L(θ) ── */ var PC = { x: 495, y: 548 }, PR = 50; function polarLabel(str, x, y, size, fill, bold) { return polarG.text(str).font({ family: 'sans-serif', size: size, anchor: 'middle', weight: bold ? 'bold' : 'normal' }) .fill(fill).move(x, y) .attr({ 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#ffffff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); } function renderPolar(px, py, blackCount) { polarG.clear(); polarG.circle(PR * 2).center(PC.x, PC.y).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#d5d5d5', width: 1 }); polarG.circle(PR).center(PC.x, PC.y).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#e8e8e8', width: 1 }); polarG.line(PC.x - PR, PC.y, PC.x + PR, PC.y).stroke({ color: '#e2e2e2', width: 1 }); polarG.line(PC.x, PC.y - PR, PC.x, PC.y + PR).stroke({ color: '#e2e2e2', width: 1 }); var M = 240, pts = [], sum = 0; for (var i = 0; i < M; i++) { var th = 2 * Math.PI * i / M; var ux = Math.cos(th), uy = -Math.sin(th); var v = castRay(px, py, ux, uy); sum += v; pts.push([PC.x + PR * v * ux, PC.y + PR * v * uy]); } polarG.polygon(pts).fill({ color: '#4a90d9', opacity: 0.4 }).stroke({ color: '#2b6cb0', width: 2 }); polarG.circle(4).center(PC.x, PC.y).fill('#2b6cb0'); polarLabel('angular light distribution L(θ)', PC.x, PC.y - PR - 24, 15, '#333', false); polarLabel('0°', PC.x + PR + 13, PC.y - 4, 11, '#999', false); polarLabel('180°', PC.x - PR - 16, PC.y - 4, 11, '#999', false); polarLabel('90°', PC.x, PC.y - PR - 10, 11, '#999', false); var mean = sum / M; var col = blackCount <= 6 ? '#c0392b' : '#1e8449'; polarLabel('directions with light: ' + blackCount + ' / 24 mean L = ' + mean.toFixed(2), PC.x, PC.y + PR + 18, 13, col, true); } polarG.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('L(θ) at the sampling point — radius = intensity arriving from each direction', e); }) .on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); showPopup('Dense vs sparse', 'In free space this curve is non-zero all around: light arrives from every direction. Inside the pinhole camera it collapses to a narrow wedge aimed at the aperture — nearly every directional value of the plenoptic function is zero there.'); }); /* ── Modes ── */ var P = { x: 440, y: 300 }; function renderExplore() { exploreG.clear(); var sg = exploreG.group(); var n = drawSpokes(sg, P.x, P.y, 24, false); drawDot(exploreG, P.x, P.y); renderPolar(P.x, P.y, n); } var OVERVIEW_PTS = [[394, 166], [413, 442], [105, 320], [105, 500]]; function renderOverview() { overviewG.clear(); OVERVIEW_PTS.forEach(function (p, idx) { var sg = overviewG.group(); if (idx < 2) { drawSpokes(sg, p[0], p[1], 16, false); } else { drawSpokes(sg, p[0], p[1], 16, true); // blocked directions shown faint drawGapRay(sg, p, CAM.gap0 + 3); // the two surviving rays through the pinhole drawGapRay(sg, p, CAM.gap1 - 3); } drawDot(overviewG, p[0], p[1]); }); } function setMode(m) { if (m === 'overview') { overviewG.show(); exploreG.hide(); polarG.hide(); } else { overviewG.hide(); exploreG.show(); polarG.show(); } } /* ── Guided steps + toggle controls ── */ var STEPS = [ { label: '1 / 4', mode: 'overview', btn: null, pos: null, text: 'The plenoptic function L(x, θ) records the light arriving at every point x from every direction θ. It is sampled here at four locations: two in free space, two inside a pinhole camera.' }, { label: '2 / 4', mode: 'explore', btn: 'free', pos: [440, 300], text: 'In free space, light arrives from every direction — the angular distribution is dense: all 24 sampled directions are nonzero (sky, tree, bird, camera body).' }, { label: '3 / 4', mode: 'explore', btn: 'cam', pos: [230, 412], text: 'Inside the pinhole camera the box blocks almost every direction. Only rays through the pinhole survive, so L(x, θ) is sparse — a narrow wedge of nonzero values.' }, { label: '4 / 4', mode: 'explore', btn: null, pos: [520, 180], text: 'Explore: click anywhere in the scene to sample L(x, θ) there — try the tree, the bird, or a point just inside the pinhole.' } ]; var currentStep = 0; var narrationEl = document.getElementById('demoNarration'); var stepLabelEl = document.getElementById('stepLabel'); function setActiveBtn(which) { document.getElementById('freeBtn').classList.toggle('active', which === 'free'); document.getElementById('camBtn').classList.toggle('active', which === 'cam'); } function applyStep(i) { currentStep = ((i % STEPS.length) + STEPS.length) % STEPS.length; var s = STEPS[currentStep]; narrationEl.textContent = s.text; stepLabelEl.textContent = s.label; if (s.mode === 'overview') { setMode('overview'); renderOverview(); } else { P.x = s.pos[0]; P.y = s.pos[1]; setMode('explore'); renderExplore(); } setActiveBtn(s.btn); } function nextStep() { applyStep(currentStep + 1); } function prevStep() { applyStep(currentStep - 1); } function trigger_freeSpace() { applyStep(1); } function trigger_insideCam() { applyStep(2); } /* ── Click anywhere to move the sampling point ── */ function toLocal(e) { var ctm = draw.node.getScreenCTM(); if (!ctm) return null; var pt = draw.node.createSVGPoint(); pt.x = e.clientX; pt.y = e.clientY; return pt.matrixTransform(ctm.inverse()); } draw.on('click', function (e) { var pt = toLocal(e); if (!pt) return; P.x = Math.max(20, Math.min(W - 20, pt.x)); P.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(H - 20, pt.y)); setMode('explore'); renderExplore(); currentStep = 3; narrationEl.textContent = STEPS[3].text; stepLabelEl.textContent = 'explore'; setActiveBtn(null); }); /* ── Init: step 0 reproduces the source figure ── */ applyStep(0); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
